Name: Ben-Hadad III, King of Syria
Summary: Ben-Hadad, son of Hazael, reigned after his father and oppressed Israel until Jehoahaz prayed, and Jehoash recovered from him the cities his father had taken.
KeyStory: Ben-Hadad III oppresses Israel until Jehoash recovers the cities.
RelatedPeople: Hazael, King of Syria; Jehoahaz, King of Israel; Jehoash, King of Israel
LifeLesson: Oppression outlives the oppressor, but so does God's answer to prayer.
